packet.claim: The recovery check rejects a fenced JSON object as input before applying recover_json_object, so the documented fence-recovery rule is never exercised.
packet.execution_evidence: INVALID_INSTANTIATION: '```\n{"a": 1}\n```' is not a cell of this grammar
packet.expected: recover_json_object should recover the JSON object inside the code fence, e.g. {"a": 1}.
packet.observed: The check returns INVALID_INSTANTIATION with detail 'the input is not the cell it names: MINI_USETEST_CELL_UNREADABLE: ... is not a cell of this grammar'.
packet.scope: All inputs consisting solely of a fenced JSON object
packet.source_basis: The object scored is the last one inside a code fence when any fence holds one, else the last top-level object in the text
packet.uncertainty: Whether the grammar-cell requirement is an intentional precondition of the test harness; the documented rule does not mention it.
